# AI Tenets

> AI defined by four tenets - Cost, Bridge, Work, Theory - each as low as possible. By Joshua Almeida.

- [Rules](https://github.com/fitzyracing1/ai-tenets/blob/main/RULES.md): canonical definition
- [tenets.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fitzyracing1/ai-tenets/main/tenets.json): machine-readable
- [Full text](https://fitzyracing1.github.io/ai-tenets/llms-full.txt)
- [bound-loop](https://github.com/fitzyracing1/bound-loop): bounded bucket loop
- [The ladder](https://fitzyracing1.github.io/ai-tenets/#ladder): bit -> local -> pi -> tenets (exact -> finite -> infinite -> deciding what's enough)
